summary: Iteration 2 - business logic expansion E2E test complete. Added /app/backend/tests/test_mill_expansion.py with 7 pytest classes covering Settings GET/PUT, Production (inventory decrement/increment + cost allocation + over-stock rejection 400), Grinding (Cash vs Grain paths, output_atta & loss_kg math, grain_fee added to Atta stock, Edit reverses+reapplies, Delete reverses), Oil (retained_oil/cake added to Mustard Oil & Cake stock, Edit reverses+reapplies, Delete reverses), Exchange (Wheat Crop += / Atta -=, Delete reverses), Sale Edit (net stock correctness) + Mark-as-Paid (invoice linked), Daybook (income/collected/pending/expenses/net/counts). All 7 tests pass 100%. Legacy /app/backend/tests/test_agrimill.py from iter-1 still passes 21/21. Frontend Playwright E2E as admin: sidebar shows Production & Exchange nav items, Dashboard shows Today's Summary card (daily-summary testid) with orange/green theme, Production dialog auto-fills Wheat Crop -> Atta+Bran and successfully created a run with inventory changes, Exchange dialog customer select uses Walk-in fallback and saves, Grinding dialog exposes grinding-washed + grinding-pay-method testids, Oil dialog exposes oil-pay-method + oil-cake testids, Sales rows expose pay-sale-{id} and edit-sale-{id} action buttons. Backend logs clean during runs; production endpoint verified (Wheat Crop 1000 -> reduced, Atta/Bran incremented with allocated cost). Oil Extraction sidebar link routes to /oil (not /oil-extraction) - both work but a console 404 route warning was seen when I tried the wrong path.

minor.issue: No validation that output quantities sum <= input quantity (mass balance). A production run can currently produce more output kg than input kg. Not requested by spec but worth noting.
Does not validate Atta stock sufficiency before decrementing; can drive Atta to negative if atta_given > current stock. Same pattern in grinding grain-fee path.
PUT edit does not re-validate stock for the new grain_fee/retained values; relies on reverse-then-apply which can transiently produce negative stock (no atomic guard).

ui_bugs.issue: Persistent Radix a11y console warning 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for DialogContent' - carried over from iter-1, still not fixed.

issues: Orange/green theme applied cleanly; Today's Summary card renders with 6 KPIs (Income Billed, Collected, Pending, Expenses, Net Cash, Orders Today). Charts and pie render with brand orange. Contrast good.

action_items: (Optional) Add mass-balance validation on POST /api/production so sum(outputs.qty) <= input_quantity.
(Optional) Validate Atta stock >= atta_given in /api/exchanges and Atta >= grain_fee_kg in /api/grinding to prevent negative stock.
(LOW) Add <DialogDescription> to each shadcn Dialog to silence Radix a11y warning (carried from iter-1).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 953 lines - exceeded the 700-line threshold; should be split into modules (auth, inventory, services, production, reports).
build_grinding_doc / apply_grinding_effects / edit_grinding pattern is clean and idempotent (reverse then reapply, keeping invoice_number). Good.
add_stock_with_cost implements proper weighted-average cost_per_unit accumulation - verified via TestProduction.
Production POST returns 400 when input_quantity > stock and 404 when input_product_id missing - correct.
PATCH /*/pay endpoints update both the record and the linked invoice - verified.
Daybook date filter uses str(i.get('date',''))==date exact-match; assumes ISO YYYY-MM-DD dates, which matches frontend today() usage.
Exchange stores loss_kg but does not persist output_atta computed from loss; loss_kg computed as wheat_qty*loss/100 rather than wheat_qty - atta_given (still consistent with spec).
seed_data_creation: TEST_ prefixed suppliers/customers created; module cleanup removes TEST_ suppliers. Purchase (200kg Wheat Crop @ ₹25), production run (100kg -> 85 Atta + 13 Bran), grinding (Cash 100kg, Grain 100kg edited then deleted), exchange (created then deleted), oil (created then deleted), sale (created then edited then deleted) - so most transient data cleaned up. Cash grinding + cash sales + supplier purchase remain in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two backend test files now: test_agrimill.py (baseline) and test_mill_expansion.py (new business logic). Run each with `python -m pytest -n 0 backend/tests/<file> -v` because they share state via pytest module attrs. All requested data-testids exist and work (production-mill/input/input-qty/output-N/output-qty-N, add-production-btn, save-production-btn, add-exchange-btn, exchange-customer/washed/wheat/loss/atta, save-exchange-btn, grinding-washed, grinding-pay-method, oil-pay-method, oil-cake, pay-sale-*, edit-sale-*, daily-summary). Oil Extraction route is /oil (not /oil-extraction). Customer select fallback 'Walk-in' works when no customers exist.
